title: 4-Day All American Washington DC - Niagara Falls Round Trip Tour
includes: 1 Night Hotel Accommodation in Niagara Falls.
2 Night Hotel Accommodation in Washington DC.
Maid of the Mist boat tour tickets.
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
One suitcase "carry on" per passenger is recommended.

All though this excursion is within the United States, it goes up to the border line. If you wish to cross into Canada, be aware that US Citizens need a passport card or booklet, as well a REAL ID*. European citizens need to apply and bring recent Electronic Travel Authorization (ETA). Other countries should check Visa entry requirements to Canada before traveling.

All multiday excursions depart early in the morning and return in late afternoon. Passengers must arrive at least one day prior to the excursion and must schedule the departure flight, one day after returning.
cancellation:
If you cancel at least 6 full day(s) before the scheduled departure time, you will receive a full refund.
If you cancel between 2 and 6 day(s) before the scheduled departure time, you will receive a 50% refund.
If you cancel within 2 day(s) of the scheduled departure, you will receive a 0% refund.
blurb:
Wonderful excursion to Niagara Falls from Washington DC. A historic visit to the nation’s capital followed by a road trip filled with historic sites and astonishing great lake’s view, an unforgettable breathtaking journey.
This thoughtfully planned multiday escorted tour of Washington DC & Niagara Falls is designed to be the unforgettable getaway everyone deserves at least once in their life!
Experience the thunder roar and stunning views of the Bridal Veil, and Horseshoe Falls from the deck of the Maid of the Mist. Also visit the Whirlpool viewpoint at Niagara Parks.
Enjoy the spectacular fireworks over the falls, a must to experience! Evening casino gambling, perhaps crossing into Canada to dine, or family time at Clifton Hill amusement attractions...! 
In Niagara Falls there is fun for everyone. Guaranteed!
